lead.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon with a 1M-token output limit
lead.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model aimed at software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and defensive cybersecurity, with an industry-leading 1 million token output limit in a single pass — up from the previous 64K. The rollout is deliberately gated: it starts with trusted cyber-defense partners via the Fairwind Program before broader developer and consumer access, at an introductory price of $2/$10 per million input/output tokens.

top_stories.title: ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B in employee tender offer
top_stories.summary: A $300M employee tender led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price values the AI voice startup at $22B, twice its February Series D mark — a liquidity event rather than new primary capital.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek open-sources six software modules for Huawei Ascend, taking aim at CUDA
top_stories.summary: DeepSeek shipped a TileLang version optimized for the Ascend 950 plus compute and communication libraries (DeepGEMM, DeepEP, FlashMLA), deepening the DeepSeek-Huawei partnership as China assembles a full stack to reduce reliance on Nvidia.

top_stories.title: Anthropic: robots can do 74% of physical US job tasks — but stay uncompetitive
top_stories.summary: A new robot exposure index finds present-day robots can perform about 74% of physical US job tasks (34% of working hours) yet are cost-competitive for only 0.3% of them; robots plus LLMs expose roughly 80% of job tasks by working time.

top_stories.title: Italian startups close a record September: EUR 388.5M across 24 rounds
top_stories.summary: Italian tech startups raised EUR 388.55 million in September 2026, more than four times a year earlier, anchored by physical-AI cybersecurity scaleup Exein's $270M round and pushing the year-to-date total above EUR 1.1 billion.

items.title: RSIGame: autonomous agentic game development with recursive self-improvement
items.summary: An agentic game-dev framework with explore-diagnose-improve loops pushes Qwen3.8-27B past GPT-5.5 one-shot scores on GameCraft-Bench while cutting generation tokens 11x.

items.title: Scaling laws for looped mixture-of-experts models
items.summary: Derives joint scaling laws combining recurrence and sparsity — previously modeled only separately — quantifying how computational depth trades off against total capacity at fixed active compute.

items.title: DC-SAE: a deep-compression semantic autoencoder for faster diffusion convergence
items.summary: A 32x spatial compression autoencoder with a pixel-level detail branch beats DC-AE by 13.5% PSNR and 54.9% gFID at 512x512 while accelerating diffusion training.

items.title: WorldAuditBench: can agents audit interactive 3D worlds?
items.summary: A 213-task, 13-environment benchmark tests whether multimodal agents can couple navigation and visual reasoning to catch floating objects or traversable walls. Five frontier models score 6.6-42.3% versus 83.4% for humans.

items.title: RoboCoach: world models as active coaches for compositional robot skills
items.summary: Using imagined failures inside a shared world model to decide which demonstrations to collect lifts success from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX.

items.title: Ideogram open weights coming to Hugging Face
items.summary: Hugging Face teased that Ideogram model weights are landing on huggingface.co/ideogram-ai — a significant addition to the open image-generation landscape.

items.title: Audio8 ASR Infinite: native streaming speech recognition with constant memory
items.summary: A streaming ASR system that decodes ~12.5 times per second with a rolling KV cache for constant memory and latency in always-on use, with demos on Hugging Chat and Gradio.

items.title: LongLive-Plug: a once-for-all distillation recipe for video generation
items.summary: A new distillation approach for video generation claiming a once-for-all recipe, shared with paper and code on Hugging Face.

items.title: SGLang community passes 2,000 contributors and holds its first summit
items.summary: LMSYS reports major community growth for SGLang, the efficient LLM serving engine — now past 2,000 contributors and 19,000 commits — plus the project's first summit.

items.title: LEGO-Anything: coding agents for 3D scene reconstruction
items.summary: An agent-driven pipeline that reconstructs 3D scenes, part of the fast-moving wave of agentic releases flowing through Hugging Face Daily Papers.

items.title: Apptronik accelerates Apollo 2 rollout with full architecture and 25 kg payload
items.summary: Austin-based Apptronik is speeding up commercial deployment of its flagship Apollo 2 humanoid, disclosing full system architecture details for the 25 kg-payload warehouse platform.

items.title: Eni and Generative Bionics sign MoU on humanoid robots for industrial sites
items.summary: The Italian energy major and the French humanoid maker will develop applications for the GENE.01 robot in energy-industry environments, targeting better impact absorption, grip and durability.

items.title: Singapore launches Home Team Humanoid Robotics Centre
items.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs officially opened H2RC to develop and test intelligent robots, including humanoids, that can work alongside officers in real operational environments.

items.title: Humanoid robot walks blind across grass, gravel and steep ramps
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated a humanoid traversing grass, wood chips, gravel and a 15-degree ramp with no cameras, LiDAR or external sensors — relying entirely on proprioceptive sensing.

items.title: Roboticist: safety, not capability, should lead the humanoid debate
items.summary: A robotics researcher reviews where two-legged robots stand in September 2026 and argues the open risks of deploying them near people deserve the top slot as funding and hype climb.

items.title: Instagram rolls out an AI video assistant for creators in Edits
items.summary: A conversational AI assistant in Instagram's CapCut competitor now gives creators personalized editing feedback instead of generic advice, rolling out from September 30.

items.title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
items.summary: A personal AI agent takes food orders over text, removing the need to navigate the app — a shot at Uber Eats and Grubhub in the race for task-completing personal agents.

items.title: Lathoa: a math app for kids where the AI is wrong on purpose
items.summary: The AI tutor deliberately makes mistakes so children have to spot and correct them. The top tool launch of the day on Hacker News (42 points).

items.title: Parrot: open-source smart meeting recorder with an on-device co-pilot for Mac
items.summary: A private alternative to tools like Granola — an open-source meeting recorder with a local AI co-pilot (31 points on Show HN).

items.title: APIAxess: free zero-setup API testing, a Burp/Caido alternative
items.summary: A free interception/proxy tool for API testing that requires no installation, drawing notable traction on Hacker News.

items.title: PA Minister Zangrillo: 1,000 AI experts programme continues into 2027
items.summary: At the BIP event on European sovereignty and AI, Zangrillo confirmed Italy will keep embedding 1,000 AI experts in public administrations in 2027 and outlined a digital electoral card to replace the paper one.

items.title: Billding closes EUR 530K round backed by Satispay and SOStariffe founders
items.summary: The Milan-based automated bill-analysis startup raised from a syndicate of Italian serial entrepreneurs and targets EUR 1.5M in revenue in 2026.

items.title: Light robotics seen as the answer to Italy's grape-harvest labour gap
items.summary: An analysis argues Italian viticulture must invest in light robotics and AI-assisted harvesting to address vendemmia labour shortages, framing agri-robotics as a deep-tech frontier for Italian startups.

items.title: Valor, Atreides and Sequoia back Flow Engineering at a $750M valuation
items.summary: The AI-agents-for-hardware-design startup lands Valor, Atreides Management and Sequoia at $750M, with former Sequoia chief Roelof Botha joining as angel investor and board member.

items.title: Restate lands $20M for durable infrastructure for AI agents
items.summary: The Berlin-based startup's durable execution engine makes multistep agent workflows resilient to crashes and network failures, built on its own storage and replication layers.

items.title: Two Google alumni raise an $11.3M fund for AI startups enterprises will pay for
items.summary: BAG Ventures closes an $11.3M Fund I betting the era of enterprise AI experimentation is ending and customers will pay only for products that prove their worth.
